scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:integration:local: sh -c 'set -e; trap "docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v" EXIT; docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait; TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://application_tracker:application_tracker@localhost:55432/application_tracker_test npm run test:integration'
scripts.local:start: docker compose up -d --wait && npm run db:migrate && npm run dev
scripts.lint: prettier --check README.md package.json docker-compose.yml docker-compose.test.yml .github client/app client/e2e client/playwright.config.ts server/src server/migrations
scripts.format: prettier --write README.md package.json docker-compose.yml docker-compose.test.yml .github client/app client/e2e client/playwright.config.ts server/src server/migrations
